about_the_game:
🔥 [Cool and trendy figures, collect as you like]

From energetic loli to cool mecha, from arrogant girl to cool queen - blind box unboxing experience, rare paint, limited skin free to match, build your own figure wall! Collect, cultivate, interact, satisfy your dream of a complete illustration!

🏠 [Creative backyard, free dress-up]

Medieval castle, sci-fi airship, oriental martial arts hall... a variety of themed furniture can be matched at will! Create a unique display space and let your figures live in a dream mansion! Limited furniture for activities is free to get, collectors' happiness is never limited!

⏳ [Easy to hang up, lie down and win]

Working for figures, resources are automatically credited! You can grow even offline, receive generous rewards with one click, say goodbye to the liver and brush the book, and enjoy the fun of placing to truly nourish the liver!

🎮 [Strategic formation, brain-burning matching]

Frost control? Flame burst? Or assault and quick attack? Freely adjust the position and develop your own school! Every battle is a game of strategy, making your figure team's combat power explode!

💎 [Limited Events, Continuous Surprises]

Rare paint jobs, out-of-print furniture, special figures... a lot of welfare activities are launched in turn! You can easily take away limited collections by participating, so that your display cabinet will always be at the forefront of fashion!

👉 Join now and start your journey as a figure master!

Easy collection × Free dress-up × Strategic battle × Buddhist cultivation

——Your figure kingdom is dominated by you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Window 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Window 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i7
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: Unboxing a blind box unlocks hundreds of figures, with free painting and personalized matching; creative backyard decoration, offline and easy cultivation. Deep strategic formation, develop unique schools such as frost/flame!
